`indexed-v1-roads.mkregions` is the public MIT `examples/roads` synthetic source,
packed with MapKit `932fce28d7f5a9807ff2f34b189d3b82afb22026`, one cell per region.
It freezes pre-L01-C index-v1 bytes for backward reader/audit and geometry tests.
It contains no external map data or private application source.
